data.title: Vertex to Present New Data on ALYFTREK® at the North American Cystic Fibrosis Conference
data.description: In Boston, Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated shared new interim data from the ALYFTREK® study showing promising results for children aged 2 to 5. The study involved vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor and revealed a restoration of exocrine pancreatic function in some children, enabling them to stop pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy (PERT). Previously, it was thought that pancreatic exocrine insufficiency in young CF patients was irreversible. This development signifies a significant breakthrough in the treatment of CF, especially for this age group.

data.title: AHF Champions Girls’ Health, Rights and Futures on International Day of the Girl
data.description: In Los Angeles, on the occasion of the International Day of the Girl (celebrated on Oct. 11 annually), the AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) is urging for increased efforts to provide girls worldwide with necessary resources for health, education, protection, and opportunities to succeed. Despite advancements over the years, significant obstacles still hinder girls' progress. HIV disproportionately impacts girls in various regions globally, with girls representing over two-thirds of new infections in 2025.
